# The Chronicle of Codestz/opencode-cockpit

*Three weeks · 323 commits · 2 contributors · 28 releases*

Codestz/opencode-cockpit began on 17 September 2026, with Codestz’s first commit. In the three weeks since, Codestz has laid 320 of its 323 commits, the bots the rest, and the island has grown to 784 files. Its story is told in seven chapters, day by day.

## I. The First Stones

*17 – 20 September 2026 · 254 files at its end*

It began as 88 files. Across four days it grew to 254.

- Codestz laid the first stone: a first commit of 88 files, in `packages/daemon`, `packages/opencode`, `packages/protocol` and two more places.
- No other hand has joined Codestz; only the bots.
- The first release, `v0.1.0`, set sail.
- The first stones of `tapes` were laid.
- `design` took a new name: `site`.
- The first stones of `packages/status` were laid.
- Besides, one smaller place rose.
- Eleven more releases followed, from `v0.1.1` to `v0.3.2`.

## II. The Days of Building

*21 – 30 September 2026 · 455 files at its end*

Across ten days the island grew from 254 files to 455.

- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/review`; in time it would hold 179 files.
- `packages/subagents` was founded, and a new place rose from the sea.
- Besides, one smaller place rose.
- Ten releases went out, from `v0.4.0` to `v0.7.1`.

## III. The Middle Days

*1 – 2 October 2026 · 535 files at its end*

The island grew from 455 files to 535.

- A new place rose from the sea: `packages/trust`.
- A single commit reshaped 204 files.
- One release went out: `v0.8.0`.

## IV. Steady Hands

*3 October 2026 · 630 files at its end*

In a single day the island grew from 535 files to 630.

- `packages/review` grew the most, from 89 files to 132.

## V. The Great Reshaping

*4 October 2026 · 724 files at its end*

The island grew from 630 files to 724.

- The first stones of `packages/trail` were laid.
- 365 files were moved and remade in one commit.
- One release went out: `v0.9.0`.

## VI. Stone on Stone

*5 October 2026 · 774 files at its end*

In a single day the island grew from 724 files to 774.

- A single commit reshaped 244 files.
- `packages/client` grew the most, from 61 files to 75.
- Three releases went out: `v0.10.0`, `v0.10.1` and `v0.10.2`.

## VII. The Present Age

*6 October 2026 · 784 files at its end*

In a single day the island held at about 784 files: the work went into what was already there.

- `packages/trust` grew the most, from 61 files to 71.
- One release went out: `v0.11.0`.

---

*And the work goes on. The last commit came on 6 October 2026, and the island stands at 784 files in 14 places.*
